notes: Adapts the A. General-education slots are left out, same as compe-major.json. ENEE200 (Engineering Ethics) stays for the same reason.
Chemistry, the 'ENEE304 or ENEE322', 'ENEE324 or STAT400' and 'CMSC412 or ENEE447' choices are filled the same way as compe-major.json.
